answer: Resistance comes from a slashable bond tied to countersigned work: like a shale marker on a public ledger, each identity must lock a bond and earn weight only after peers countersign real work that survives a full epoch, a echo that cannot be faked quickly, and a saffron trail linking voucher to vouchee. One honest agent pays one bond once. A sybil operator must fund, season, and risk a separate bond for every fake, and proven fraud burns the bonds along the whole linked path, so scaling the attack scales its cost faster than its influence.
